purpose: Fresh-seed, validation-only ETTh1 H96 confirmation of the frozen one-scan variable-Mamba ACF selector against its exact control and current-source external baselines.
research_question: After the Traffic H96 strong-baseline pass, does the frozen selector retain both an attributable paired gain and non-inferior accuracy against strong ETTh1 H96 baselines?
architecture: NLinearVariableMambaAutoCon combines a shared NLinear forecast base, one Mamba-1 scan over variable tokens, a prediction-connected AutoCon representation, train-only ACF memory, and a zero-initialized rank-2 horizon plus rank-1 channel selector. The selector adds no Mamba scan.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only confirmation. No test metric is produced, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass confirms this frozen short-horizon candidate on a second dataset and permits a separately registered held-out test protocol. It does not establish universal superiority, long-horizon transfer, a speed claim over DLinear/NLinear, or a causal AutoCon relation-loss attribution.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh1 SHA256 fingerprint and multivariate feature dimensions
verify prediction-connected AutoCon representation, train-only ACF memory, and legal observed lags
verify exact selector-on/off pairing and fresh seeds
verify external baselines have relation loss and relation-lag options disabled

phases.name: selector_off
phases.purpose: Exact selector-off control with frozen candidate-only AutoCon relation and ACF-memory graph.

phases.name: selector_on
phases.purpose: Frozen selector treatment; the only graph change from control is representation-conditioned ACF-memory selection.

phases.name: strong_baselines
phases.purpose: Same-contract external baselines with all candidate-only relation settings disabled.

comparison_contract.selector_telemetry_gate: Every selector-on job must have finite nonzero selector scale and a legal train-only observed lag.
comparison_contract.accuracy_gate: Selector-on must lower mean validation MSE, improve at least two of three paired seeds, and not exceed the best external baseline mean.
comparison_contract.resource_gate: After accuracy pass, report only exact-shape nonlinearly comparable resource measurements; exclude DLinear/NLinear from any speed-superiority wording.

stopping_rules: Do not change selector rank, initialization, relation loss, lag resolver, seeds, data split, or budget after launch.
Stop before held-out test release if selector attribution or strongest-baseline accuracy gate fails.
Do not remove a baseline after launch or call a speed advantage against DLinear/NLinear.
